PC specs are absurd, asking for 8 GB VRAM (when RDR2 only asks for 2 GB) is extremely amateurish and clearly a crutch for lackluster optimization. This is unacceptable for an indie game, its a very clear example of "Unreal slop".

Possible optimization improvements: 
[list]
    [*]LOD's (not just Nanite, actual LOD's)
    [*]Occlusion culling
    [*]Object pooling (if it applies)
    [*]Resolution scaling
    [*]Avoid the use of volumetrics (since they are very performance costly and have much better alternatives)
    [*]Avoid the use of Nanite and learn how to properly make lowpoly 3D assets with baked maps.
    [*]Bake texture atlasses on compilation time to reduce texture draw calls in runtime
    [*]Bake static lighting and avoid excessive usage of runtime lighting calculation
[/list]

thoughts:

Its not terrible? In its current state its a definite no though.

Pros:

game has decent enough graphics
the sound quality is nice
i like the variety of items you can loot
the spooky ambiance is definitely there

Cons: 

you walk and swing your weapon like a drunk person would.

the game is unreasonably dark. I'm talking switch to a bow and suddenly you're blind. Why even have options to use other equips, if a torch is mandatory for 95% of a run? 

the inventory system desperately needs a rotate item option. Often you will find equips you cant take. You have the space, but its impossible because you cant rotate the items in your inventory to be vertical or horizontal. 

Sometimes the game throws an unreasonable amount of enemies at you. running is not always an option. So just die i guess?

Death makes you lose whatever you brought with you, okay that's fine, but what to do when you lose all your weapons from dying? Just pray to god you find a weapon before you die i guess? *shrug*

There is a lot of stuttering and lag, this needs to be ironed out, it happens most often in combat or near fires. I can run fully modded skyrim with shadders bro, there's no reason this game lags besides poor optimization

As is, its not a bad game, but it needs a lot a lot of work still.

Overall: 6.5/10

It feels like a bunch of amateur devs who love dark and darker started learning ue5 together and took on a project with much larger scope than they could handle. It was a fun janky mess for an hour or so with friends, but this game needs so so much work. I wouldn't bet on it having a redemption arc in the future unless they can pull off a miracle.

There's passion behind it in some areas. You can clearly see the inspiration for some of the mechanics and such, but if you're looking at it overall, it's just not good enough.

The performance and optimization is completely awful. The ui is unintuitive. Actually, pretty much everything about the game is unintuitive. Some of the good features feel forgotten, and some of the bad features feel too elevated. Again, there's potential here, but I really doubt them being able to pull this together into a cohesive, fun game. (But it's worth giving it a try, don't just read reviews. It's a free demo, try it out yourself and make your own opinion.)

reviews.review: 游戏是好游戏，喜欢玩，优化做好，然后身上提灯前面的光亮可以增强一点，可以稍微做点引导，有助于路痴哈哈哈。

¿Te gustan las mazmorras? ¿Te gusta la estrategia? ¿Te gusta pasarla bien con amigos? ¿Te gustan los desafíos? ¿Te gusta lotear? ¿Te gusta gestionar tu propio campamento, vender objetos, completar misiones? ¿Te gusta echarte un buen rato con tus compas? ¿Te gusta pelear contra jefes y criaturas realmente difíciles?

Déjame decirte que este juego es para ti. Es de entender que es una demo, pero por dios, que buenos gráficos, iluminación y ambientación. Es realmente bueno, se ha convertido en uno de mis juegos favoritos de mazmorras.

Sí, la creación del personaje es algo escaza, algunos movimientos se sienten algo toscos, pero TODO LO OTRO lo compensa, y no solo eso, tiene un potencial tremendo, tiene TODO para convertirse en un juegazo. Si así como está, ya es bueno, tiene mazmorras super grandes, que todo lo que he jugado y no he explorado toda la 1er mazmorra, me pierdo por sus caminos, no me imagino con más contenido.

Lo recomiendo al 100%, es una gran experiencia.

Cabe aclarar que tengo un pc gama alta y me corre perfecto. No esperes tú un rendimiento genial, teniendo en cuenta que es una demo.

Saludos,
El Breicod.

以下改善してほしいこと
・EキーのインタラクトやQキーの回復は長押ししないとキャンセルされるのでだるい
・インベントリのグリッドに綺麗に合わせてアイテムをドラッグしないと元の位置に戻されるのがイライラする（スナップが弱い）
・装備画面とインベントリ画面がタブで分かれているため装備の入れ替えがだるい
・クイック使用スロットに対応しているアイテムを倉庫にクイック移動できないのがだるい
・マウスオーバーでアイテムの名前が表示されないためいちいち詳細画面を開いて名称を確認する必要がある
・アイテムの詳細画面を❌️ボタンで閉じる必要がある（Escで閉じようとするとインベントリ全体が閉じるのでイライラ）
・タスク一覧を確認する画面がないためタスクの内容を確認するためにトレーダーのタスク依頼画面まで遷移する必要がある
・30cmくらいの段差が登れない
・30cmくらいの段差で落下ダメージを受ける
・脱出地点の目印はなく脱出地点の名称すら教えてくれない（スポーン時の真後ろの地点から帰還することは出来る）
・敵が目の前で突然ポップすることがある
・パーティ全員が死んでも自動でロビーに遷移せず観戦画面のまま
・敵の数が多い割に敵を倒しても報酬がないことが9割でドパれない（エリートは倒したことがないので未評価）

４時間ほどプレイ、まず一言で言うとバカおもろい。

ただかなり重めのグラとバグが多めなのが難点かな。自分のpcの仕様で、最低画質（ほぼ画質変わってない）にしてもたまーにカクつく。バグも割と深刻なバグがあって戦闘中に武器が使えなくなることもある。まぁまだ発売前なのでしょうがないといえばしょうがない。
内容を簡単に言えば、dadやtarkovのように金品稼いで脱出するっていう感じ。
ただ他とは違うのは何よりPVE限定なこと。
気軽に遊べて対人ゲーのようなストレスもない。なので前述したゲームと比べてだいぶ簡単。
油断すると普通に死にかけるけどね。
あとかなり稼ぎやすい。ここらへんは好みが分かれるかもしれない。
それから魔法を使えるようになってから面白さが倍増する。dadと違い詠唱を必要とし、４つの種類のなんか属性みたいなのを矢印キー（初期設定）で選択して並べていく感じ。その組み合わせで魔法が発動できる。
ただ、代償として体が蝕まれる。これは時間経過ですぐ治っていく感じ。まぁ魔法版スタミナだと思うとわかりやすいかも。
ちなみに、過剰詠唱すると詠唱ミスになるけど、ランダムに何かしらの魔法が発動できる。これがまたすごく楽しい。そして通常より体が蝕まれる。
自分はガチャ感覚で魔法連発してたら目から紫のビーム出しながら爆散した。みなさんはこうならないよう気をつけて。
全体的な評価としては、割とゲームセンスが必須だということ。この手のゲームに慣れてるかどうか、理不尽を楽しめるかどうかが最も重要。
とりあえずdemoれ。それから考えろ。

I don't review games often, but this one scratches an itch I didn't know I even had.

I'm going to lead with the negative, because I don't want to be misleading, if you are looking for a fully fledged experience this isn't it yet.

Not going to sugar coat it, its in a very early state and it has all the hallmarks of that. There are bugs, things are poorly balanced or outright missing, the maps and enemy variety are sparse.

THAT BEING SAID

The atmosphere is top notch, and the maps that we do have are excellent. The sound effects, and danger (Especially early on) are palpable, you will be lost, out of supplies and be fighting for your life to get a cool backpack or hand tool you found out.

Your friends will get surrounded, and you will do everything in your power to save them, and it creates great gameplay moments, when a boss enemy comes through a wall after you.

You will make a cool new sword or find a new spell, and then blow yourself up or lose it.

This game has a ton of potential, and I can't wait for them to come out with more.

+ 분위기가 압도적이다. : 

다 무너진 중세배경의 마을과 성은, '도대체 내가 앞으로 뭘 상대해야 하는가' 싶은 불안감으로 사람을 위축되게 만든다. 

지상은 안개가 빽빽하여 인게임 캐릭터 기준으로 스무걸음 앞이 잘 안보이는 수준이며, 

지하는 새까만 어둠이 벽 뒤, 방 구석, 문 너머를 미지 그 자체로 만들어 걸음을 내딛는 것을 주저하게 한다.

공통적으로 지상이나 지하 둘다 들려오는 몬스터들의 괴상한 울음이나, 낄낄거리는 웃음소리는, 

안그래도 정찰병 역할의 몬스터가 존재해, '가능한 한 들키면 안되며, 큰 전투는 피해야한다.' 는 압박감에 더해,

내가 어딧는지도 제대로 파악을 못한 몹을 피해가야할지 맞서야할지 고민하게 만들고, 신경을 곤두세운다.


+ 파밍이라는 보상체계가 인게임 콘텐츠 상으로 밸런싱이 아주 잘 잡혀있다. 그리고 그게 너무 재밋다. :

아이탬이 다양하고, 도구, 잡탬, 염료, 장비, 도면 등등 각 분류마다 비싸거나 많이 필요한 것들이 두서가지씩은 꼭있다.

어지간한 물건들이 전부 던전 안에서 꽤 희소하게 드롭되는데다가,

심지어는 내 기지를 꾸려갈때 필수적인 물자들이 전부 드롭확률이 낮은 축에 속하며, 그 제작도면은 더욱 안나온다.

그렇기에 분명 PVE여서 게임의 난이도가 꽤 낮음에도 불구하고 여러번 반복해서 끊임없이 들어가야하고, 

아이템 테이블 (맵에서 등장 할 수 있는 아이템목록)이 지상과 지하 서로 틀리니, 그 횟수는 두배로 늘어난다.

횟수가 늘어나는만큼, 게임의 난이도가 어렵진 않지만 반복이 되니 억까를 당할 확률도 올라가고,

사고를 당하면 가방을 포함한 모든 아이템을 잃게 되어 친구가 주워주지않으면 회수할 방법이 없고,

마력폭발로 죽어버리는 사고는 시체마저 남지 않아 회수 자체가 불가능하니,

좋은 장비를 입을 수록 오히려 죽을까봐 불안감은 증폭된다.

좋은 보상이 나오는 곳은 서로 꽤 멀리 떨어져있는지라 이동거리가 꽤 되는데,

한 곳만 털고 나오자니 아쉽고, 더 털자니 사고가 날 것 같아 두려워지게 만든다.

아 물론, 이 맛있는 긴장감은, 데모를 하면서 '아 여기에서 나를 해할수 있는건 오우거 뿐이군.' 라는 깨달음과 함께 사라져버렸다.

///
지금부터 까겠다.

- 몬스터의 레벨 밸런싱이 너무 안잡혀있다. :

스켈레톤은 qudtls이다. 느리고, 그나마 몹같은 언데드 마법사는 쉴드만 터트리면 죽어버린다.

숫자로 밀어붙히자는 콘셉같은데, 느릿느릿하고 잘 죽지않는 대신, 죽여도 죽여도 끝이 없이 느껴지려면,

데모기준보다 한 3배는 되어야할 것이다. 지상같은 경우, 스켈레톤이 나오는 순간 그냥 프리파밍이다.

석궁 사수와 롱보우 사수 스켈레톤은 아군 오사하기에 바쁘고, 언데드 메이지는 잘 안보이는데다,

장창병은 쉴드 하나만 들고있어도 대처가능하고, 나머진 그냥 바보등신이다.

그나마 약간 몹다운 면이라면 가끔 10번 죽여도 다시 일어나는 무한 부활 특성 정도일까?

근데 이것도 은으로 떡칠한 장검 하나만 있으면 스켈레톤을 전부 개 간식으로 만들 수 있으니 하등 의미없다 하겠다.

부패한 기사를 포함한 모든 스켈레톤 몹의 숫자를 약 3배 가량 늘려버리던가, 혹은 다른 몹이 필요하다.

육신족은 분위기만 잡는 광대다. 소리랑 모션만 무섭다. 안그래도 텍스쳐가 뭉개져있어서 무섭지 않은데,

가까이 왔을때 몸을 날려와 맞아보면 데미지도 시원찮고, 모션들이 일률적인데다 내구성도 약하니,

검으로 세로베기를 해 쪼개버리면 검이 닿을 때마다 깍두기가 되어버려 김이 샌다.

황소마저, 대방패 하나만 있으면 모든 공격을 원천봉쇄하고, 그나마 잡기공격이 통하는데,

잡기공격 또한 보통 탱커가 맞는데다가, 그 탱커는 높은 수준의 방어구로 둘둘 싸매져 있을게 뻔하지 않은가.

고블린이 그나마 가장 말이 되는 밸런싱을 갖고 있었다.

특히 오우거야말로 엄청난 공포였는데, 이 오우거는 잡기 공격을 했을 시 일정확률로 즉사공격을 건다.

사람을 잡아 어금니로 머리를 씹고 뜯어내버리는데, 시전해서 씹힘을 당하는 즉시 시체가 된다.

이 부분은 약간 어이가 없었는데, 오우거가 이 처형모션이 실행되고 나면, 그 많은 오우거 피통을 깎기 전까진,

머리통이 씹힐 운명에 처한 내 불쌍한 동료를 구할 방법 자체가 존재하지 않는다.

고블린들은 이동속도도 빠르고, 숫자도 많으며, 원거리 사수들 또한 두마리씩은 꼭 데려오고,

갑옷을 입고 다니거나 방패를 들기 때문에, 어느 방향으로 검의 궤적을 잡든, 그 갑옷이나 방패가 보통 한번은 막아준다.

고블린 검이나 단검, 혹은 미늘창에 맞으면, 

전방에서 들어오는 공격은 낮은 확률로, 후방에서 들어오는 공격은 꽤 높은 확률로 '열상'이라는 상태이상에 걸리는데,

붕대를 감기 전까진 치유되지 않으며, 그 어떤 상태이상보다도 많은 데미지를 자랑한다.

적군 종족이 셋인데 하나는 맞아죽으면 그 맞아죽은 놈이 qudtls인 똥멍청이 몹이고,

또 하나는 분위기만 잡는데에 더해, 떼거리로 나오거나, 혹은 특수몹이 다수 등장하지 않는 이상 '써는 맛이 일품인 고깃덩이' 몹이고,

마지막 하나는 잘못 걸렸다 싶으면 도망가는 것 외에는 방법이 없으니 이건 밸런싱을 과연 하긴 한건가 싶다.

적으로 나오는 세 종족 다, 더 많은 기획과 그 반영이 필요하다.

- 마법 만능 게임. 이럴거면 석궁과 활, 총은 왜 만들어놨는가.

이 게임에서 속성 공격은 거의 만능이다.

위에서 설명했듯, 마법을 지나치게 남발하여, 자신이 마력중독으로 터져죽는 거대한 페널티를 제외하면,

불 마법은 적들이 순간 비명을 지르고 날뛰게하여 잠시동안 움직임을 무력화 할 수 있고, 범위도 넓다.

전기 마법은 잠시 몹들이 마비가 되는데, 미완성인지, 몇몇은 안통한다.

얼음 마법은 몹들이 얼어붙는데, 사람 근처에 뛰어와서 둘러싸놓곤 얼어붙어, 검도 시연용 허수아비로 변모한다.

마력탄은 건물들을 깨부술수 있기 때문에, 잠겨있는 문도 그냥 마력탄으로 몇번 매너없이 강력하게 노크하면,

벽 째로 부숴지면서, 내 허리 춤의 열쇠고리와 그 안에 담겨있는 여러개의 열쇠를 보며 '도대체 넌 왜 존재하는걸까?' 하는 의문을 품게 만든다.

와중, 본인은 석궁, 활, 총을 써보고 굉장히 놀랐는데, 진심으로 말한다만 왜 존재하는지 모르겠다.

일반몹 조차 머리에 대고 쏴도 죽지않는다. 왜 존재하는지 의문이다. 

장전이 빠른것도 아니고, 대형몹의 잡기 모션을 캔슬 할 수 있는 것도 아니다.

스켈레톤의 반들반들한 머릿통을 기준으로, 총은 두방, 석궁은 3~4방, 활은 무슨 머리가 화살통인지 6~7방이 꽂혀있어도 나에게 걸어온다.

다른 종족들도 육신족을 제외하면 비슷했다. 육신족은 좀 약한 모습을 보였는데, 그마저도 의미가 없는게 1방 정도 덜 맞아도 죽는다는거?

이러면 대체 왜 만든 것인가? 화살촉도 여러 종류로 나눠놨던데 하등 의미가 없다!

스켈레톤 같은 뼉다구한테 대체 열상화살이 뭔소용인가?

장전모션이든 발사를 위한 준비모션이든 전부 느려터져서 한발 쏘고 나서 재장전을 반쯤 하고나면,

내가 맞췄다고 치고, 맞춘놈은 뒤에서 머리가 어지러운지 헤드뱅잉을 하고 있고, 

바로 그 뒤에 쫓아오던 놈이 이미 내 뺨아리를 올려붙히고 있다. 장전 다하고 다시 쏠때 쯔음엔 서너마리가 날 신나게 두들기고 있다.

아무 쓸모없는 무기는 없었으면 좋겠다.

시급한 조정이 필요하다.

This is only a demo, but it's the most engaging demo I have ever been hooked on.
I will list the pros and cons but bare in mind that some if not many things are either not working, buggy, or implemented.

Pros:
- The action, there's just something very satisfying when you slay an enemy, a goblin gets slashed down, a fleshkin zombie exploding, a skeleton crumbling to pieces. The combat is "simple" but there are complexities to it with having to manage your stamina, your attack direction, being mindful of your surrounding so your weapon doesn't bounce off the environment, and no spamming attacks because it queues up all your inputs.
- For a game with low spec requirements it looks really dang good. probably in part with the lighting and the darkness masking any imperfections in the graphics.
- Customization is fun, from making the clothing to the color you want, to making your own personal weapon that you can name with parts to make your weapon more deadly. For a demo there are many things you can do to customize your weapon and it's good.
- 5 player coop pve, that's pretty great and lots of fun when we're all trying to survive, loot, and escape alive.
- There is so much to loot. if you're a loot gremlin this game is for you. Many many items to loot on the map to make yourself stronger, build up your base, things for quest lines, etc.
- 50 quests, for a demo it sure gives you a lot to do.
- PvE focused over PvP, there will be pvp but it's more of an afterthrough. the PvE is where the main focus is.
- The music and sound work is good. it sounds great, very fitting of the mood.

Cons:
- Skills not implemented, most of them are not working or working as intended which messed up my build but it's not a huge deal. Some skills could use a buff to make them better than what it is currently.
- the drop rates of items you NEED: This part is a natural part of any game with loot. however some of the vital material you need for quests or your base upgrade has a lot of randomness before you even get what you're looking for.
- UI, the user interface could be a tad more refined, because first time I played the game some of the options or different pages weren't obvious to me until someone pointed out I could flip through pages within the menu. Not the tabs on top, but the tab category. Ex. I didn't realize in the CAMP section you could flip to different parts of it to upgrade and thought, wow I only got a tent.

I could list more cons but it's one of those, it's a demo and it's only a matter of time before they fix or add things to the game.

I can't wait for the full release of the game with all the looting and slaying we'll be doing.
For a demo I cant believe the features I cant believe the customization. I cant believe the combat styles this a up and comer for sure. Hopefully they stick with it.

Disclaimer: The game is in essentially an alpha/early beta state right now (Aug 2026), if you don't like dealing with some jank then simply wait till more patches drop. The game shows great potential and is great fun even in it's incomplete state.

The good: 
-The game simply fun, the looting and extraction based gameplay is engaging and great to enjoy with friends
-A great aesthetic, with a wide variety of weapons and armor (some still being made)
-Combat is simple, yet still offers a variety of ways to engage enemies.  Even at ~150 hours in I am testing new weapon setups.
-Map design is great, exploring and doing quests offers ~30 hours of fresh gameplay (with more coming)
-LOOT! If you are a fellow Loot Goblin and enjoy having large pile of 500 different items you may never use then this game is for you!

The Bad:
- As of writing this review the game is a bit buggy, has sub-par optimization (patch for this in the works), and several major parts of the game are simply not finished yet (magic, wood types, and the skill tree are missing/largely incomplete).  All things that will be fixed by full release, do not mistake this for a complete game in it's current state (Aug 2026)
- The game needs some balancing, some common drops players need for basic crafting are incredibly rare *coughHandPlanecough*, and the game fails to offer enough threat to highly geared players to match the same intense gameplay loop that makes the first ~30 hours in this game so much fun. (again, all easily addressable in time)
-Graphics and enemy variety are on the lower end.  With a small team (~10 devs) this is to be expected, and several new enemy types have already been leaked by the devs.  Just don't expect the enemy quality and variety of a FromSoft game.
-Inventory.  If you HATE inventory management then you might need to steer clear of this game.  The looting/extraction loop frequently has you overburdened with valuable items trying to desperately find and extract, only to extract and have to sort out a bunch of inventory space to save things in your limited stash space.  While this creates a great feeling of surviving from moment to moment, mission to mission, with whatever you have on hand, it definitely has some tedium attached with it.  While I feel the system is implemented well, this will be a deal breaker for some players for sure.
Great game, very fun cant complain
So much potential for this. Will be watching closely.

To start, this is a review of the Demo after just 4 hours. I plan to revise this review after more time played (which there is definitely more time to be played) and after the full game comes out.

TL:DR - game needs a bit of polish, and one or two more mechanics wouldn't go amiss. Overall I really enjoy the game for it's immersion into dungeon diving, both the actual game play and the preparation work that can go a long way in how smooth the run goes. If you love the idea of going deep into a dungeon to bring back the finest items, you'll probably love this game play!

Let's start with the bad in my eyes. 

-When you die, everything on your is gone. In a PvPvE game I could totally understand this. Your body is gonna be taken apart by other players quickly, Even if you could somehow get back into the same lobby, I wouldn't expect to find my stuff un-pilfered. However in a PvE only game, I would love to see a feature allowing me to dive back in, collect my body, and hoist it out of the dungeon for a return of the gear found on it. I don't want to loot it like a corpse per-se (I don't want nude runs to recover gear) but a full body recovery system where you go in and carry it out sounds great to me in this atmosphere.

-The game lacks some level of explanation of UI systems. I think the UI in camp could do with some polishing. In particular, the crafting of weapons is great, but can be confusing. If you don't have 15 mins to just tinker around with it before you dive back into the dungeon it could be very frustrating. I know the internet has solved such issues in games long ago with forums and the like. However I don't think that is an excuse for the devs to forgo explanations of basic mechanics like adjusting your weapons and armor to better fit the enemies you are expecting to face. Like swapping out my halberds spike for a hammer when I know Skeletons are on the horizon. That said, I quite like the air of mystery and figuring out how the dungeon itself works when out on an expedition.

Those are really the only things I've been miffed by so far. I have been far more impressed with the game than disappointed, and here are some of the main reasons why. Let me be clear, I know not all people will like these systems and in some cases may even call them friction mechanics. Frankly I find them immersing and fun.

- Limited carry capacity. When you first dive into the dungeon, even with both a bag and a backpack, you will find your inventory filling up fast. Long before your actual carry capacity gets reached. Bulky items like Armor and weapons take up a LOT of space. The reason I like this is because it encourages learned the map, and deciding where you are going to loot before you ever even enter the dungeon. You don't want to fill your bags with every little thing you come across so you can sell it for a few pennies when you return. On my favorite runs, you often will delve into the dungeon for five to ten minutes to get some where, fighting a party or two of monsters on the way, before you even pick up a single piece of loot. Then once your bags are filled with the good stuff, you mosey on back out the way to you came, which leads me to my next favorite thing so far.

-No Map. I'm sure maps will pop up online before long (a quick google just showed me there are at least 2 out there already, though one appears to have been deleted?) but to me, exploring a new place like this is so much fun! As well has needing to remember where you came from to get back out. Retreating in a panic is a great way to get yourself killed. You need to be calm and collected as your retrace your steps to return to safety with your bag of goodies.

-Weapon crafting. In particular, the fact that it's not just using the same raw ingredients in ever larger quantities to get a better version of the exact same weapon. I'm talking about taking the haft of a weapon, and swapping out pommels, cross guards, blade/striker head types/ grips. It is a ton of fun collecting a few parts and then customizing your weapon based on what the game warns you is waiting in the dungeon that run. Skeletons? bring something to pulverize those bones! Fleshkin? make sure you have a sharp blade! Goblins who make sure of armor but are soft on the inside? puncturing weapons will hit the spot! You can use the same weapon haft (determining the move set) and alter the actual striking portion of the weapon to meet your needs!

-Consumable weapons are powerful! I can't count the number of games that make things like grenades and other throwables feel so... optional. In Expedition throwables can completely change a fight around. solo against eight enemies can be daunting, result in several potions being used, and taking a lot of time. A single explosive pot or fire vial can completely wipe those eight enemies out. Of course they can also be expensive... But it is a well worth trade off for how much effect they can be!

This game is a lot of fun, and has a lot of potential once you figure out the menu. I think a small tutorial of the main screen would help immensely. Once they can work out performance issues and some bugs it'll be a good co-op experience. I was killed by a chest at one point because it launched me into the sky for some reason. I would like to see more difficulty scaling for co-op, or a difficulty slider of some sort. As of now there isn't one and if one is added I hope they go the route of significantly increasing enemy spawn as opposed to. The trailer of the game makes it seems like like a left 4 dead style hoard but the enemy density was underwhelming based on the trailer. All in all, I am very excited for this game

Игра хорошая. Я вообще не понимаю, откуда такой рейтинг. Ни у меня, ни у мужа не было абсолютно никаких проблем с оптимизацией, лагов тоже не было. Если ваш компьютер не тянет игру - понизьте графику. Я ещё могу понять такой рейтинг в отношении их предыдущих тестов, которые действительно выглядели и игрались плохо. Но сейчас это уже действительно полноценная хорошая игра.

А те, кто пишет, что игра беспощадна к одиночкам, - проблемки в вас. Либо вы привыкли полностью полагаться на команду и абсолютно не ликвидны как соло-игрок, либо вы казуалы (и в этом нет ничего плохого, пока вы не начинаете срать игру только потому, что она не подходит под ваши навыки). Муж наиграл 50 часов в соло и за всё это время умер один раз - от огра. И по его мнению, это единственный враг, который действительно достаточно силён, чтобы убить тебя и создать проблемы. А ваши слёзки по поводу того, что после смерти теряешь весь лут, я даже комментировать не хочу. Эта игра просто не для вас. Идите дальше. Есть огромное количество казуальных игр, где можно спокойно бегать, ничего не терять после смерти и не испытывать душевную травму от того, что игра требует хоть каких-то навыков.

Моё мнение как человека, который участвовал в двух тестах этой игры, следит за ней уже несколько лет и наблюдал за её развитием практически с альфы: игра хорошая, у неё отличный потенциал и атмосфера. Я точно буду покупать её на релизе

Firstly I want to adress the negative reviews..

'optimisation sucks' I have an average pc and 0 issues, if you have a potato, just turn down the fog settings, issue fixed.

'it's impossible to play alone'  said by the same people who dropped elden ring after they died once.. Dying is part of the game, you can however play solo just fine, I have done complete map cleans solo, I died only twice in the 40 hours, once I got cocky. the other time I let myself be overwhelmed, not checking surroundings. you just need the right weapons and fighting style.

That being said obviously there is room for improvement, like any game, some balancing should be done, magic is currently way better for ranged than archery is. Boaters are way to easy, just sidestep them and they kill themselves, skeletons could do with some more types of enemy.
But that's where we are getting into the point that I would just like to see more content! Can't wait for the game to release, haven't been as excited for a game in years
